audit.whatIsWrong: Full layer read Skill for levels 1 through 6 while the content layer and the packet both read Katarina for levels 2 through 6.
audit.why: Bouncing Blade costs 0 mana on 11/10/9/8/7s and Shunpo costs 0 on 12/11/10/9/8s at 725 range. Azir pays 70-110 mana per Q on 14s at rank 1. A free-cost kit that blinks 725 units wins the levels-2-to-6 window, and Voracity refunds her cooldowns off any kill nearby.
audit.corrected: phases[1..4].side moved to Katarina with all four whys rewritten in this proposal; win[1..4] already read Katarina, so the layers now agree. Level 1 stays Skill on both layers.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1].text and the content mid paragraph both described Death Lotus as a global execute that punishes low-health targets anywhere on the map.
audit.why: Death Lotus is 550 range on a 75/60/45s cooldown and hits the three nearest enemy champions while she channels. It is not global and it is not an execute. Her map-wide snowball comes from Voracity refunding cooldowns on a nearby kill, which is a different mechanic.
audit.corrected: Both now state the real numbers — a 550-range channel on 75 seconds — and separate it from Voracity's reset.

audit.whatIsWrong: The single decisive interaction in this matchup was never stated anywhere on the page, and breakdown.cooldowns contained no number (lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT).
audit.why: Death Lotus is a channel — Riot's own text and the channel flag agree that any CC ends it. Emperor's Divide (120/105/90s, 250 range) knocks back, so the wall cancels her ultimate outright. That is the reason to hold R rather than open with it, and the page never said it.
audit.corrected: Stated in tldr, winCon, spikes[1].text, the mid paragraph, breakdown.cooldowns and dontsFull[2].d, with Shunpo 12-8s / 725 range and Death Lotus 75-45s written out.

audit.whatIsWrong: Twenty-two lint findings: MISGENDER across tldr, winCon, tradeGood, loading, two phase whys, wave, trading, three Do's, one Don't and five report entries; two COPY_PASTE_BLEED bullets; the empty cooldowns field.
audit.why: Katarina is female per champ-data/champ-gender.js. dosFull[1].d was tradeGood verbatim under a shove-and-ping title, dontsFull[2].d was tradeBad verbatim under a roam-pinging title.
audit.corrected: Pronouns fixed in every field I edited; both bled bullets replaced with bodies that match their titles.

audit.whatIsWrong: Derived-flag misfires noted, not written to the page.
audit.why: The kit file tags Katarina's Q with 'grounding' and her W with 'knockup', but Riot's descriptions for those slots say only that the dagger bounces and ricochets, and that she gains move speed and tosses a dagger upward. Per the brief, the description wins over a contradicting flag.
audit.corrected: No grounding or knockup claim written anywhere in this proposal.
